description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。

>若您未指定ClientToken，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

>If you do not specify ClientToken, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request.

description.zh:
待彻底删除文件或目录的FileId。

您可以通过调用[ListRecycledDirectoriesAndFiles](~~2412174~~)接口查询已删除数据的FileId信息。
description.en:
The FileId of the file or directory that you want to permanently delete.

You can call the [ListRecycledDirectoriesAndFiles](~~2412174~~) operation to query the FileId of deleted data.

title.zh: 彻底删除回收站中暂存的文件或目录
title.en: Permanently delete a file or directory from the recycle bin

descriptions.zh:
- 仅通用型NAS文件系统支持该功能。
- 需要启用回收站。
- 通过 NFS/SMB 挂载该文件系统（需要使用同VPC内的ECS实例挂载），在挂载目录中删除目标文件使其进入回收站。
- 彻底删除目录时，目录中的内容会被递归清理。
- 单个文件系统一次只能执行一个彻底删除任务。正在彻底删除文件或目录时，无法发起新的恢复或清理任务。
descriptions.en:
- Only General-purpose NAS file systems support this feature.
- The recycle bin must be enabled.
- Mount the file system by using NFS or SMB (mount the file system on an ECS instance in the same VPC), and then delete the target file in the mount directory to move it to the recycle bin.
- When you permanently delete a directory, the contents of the directory are recursively deleted.
- Only one permanent deletion task can be run at a time for a single file system. While a file or directory is being permanently deleted, you cannot initiate a new restoration or cleanup task.
